notes: prefilter=on drives the production handler path (handlers.search.resolve_search_pool): the FTS5 candidate slice capped at 50, ranked with the corpus-IDF provider. Every question was checked for engagement; the run exits non-zero if any pool came back un-prefiltered.
scope, repo, worktree and excluded-scope filters are all unset, so the cap-starvation guard cannot reload the full corpus and silently turn the on-arm into the off-arm.
corpus digest or padding matches no committed artifact, so the prefilter=off half is a fresh measurement rather than a reproduction of one.
